req.title: Task update rejects id changes
req.statement: The system shall ignore any id field in the PUT body and only mutate the task addressed by the URL.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-038 requires that PUT /tasks/{id} ignores any 'id' field in the request body and only mutates the task addressed by the URL path parameter. Three test cases are designed: (1) Positive/EP: send a PUT body containing a different 'id' value alongside valid fields; verify the response returns HTTP 200, the URL-addressed task's id is unchanged, and the mutable fields are updated. (2) Negative/NEG: send a PUT body with an 'id' that matches a non-existent task while the URL points to an existing task; verify the existing task is updated (id not used for lookup) and the response id equals the URL id. (3) Boundary/BVA: send a PUT body where the embedded 'id' is 0 (boundary below valid ids) while the URL addresses task id=1; verify the response id equals 1, not 0, confirming the body id is ignored at the boundary. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with SQLite in-memory override to remain deterministic and idempotent.

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_test = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_test)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_test)

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_put_ignores_body_id_updates_url_task():
    r_create = client.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "Original", "completed": False})
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    task_id = r_create.json()["id"]
    fake_body_id = task_id + 999
    r_put = client.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"id": fake_body_id, "title": "Updated"})
    assert r_put.status_code == 200
    data = r_put.json()
    assert data["id"] == task_id
    assert data["id"] != fake_body_id
    assert data["title"] == "Updated"

test_put_ignores_body_id_updates_url_task()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_test3 = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal3 = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_test3)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_test3)

def override_get_db3():
    db = TestingSessionLocal3()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db3
client3 = TestClient(app)

def test_put_body_id_zero_boundary_ignored_url_task_updated():
    r_create = client3.post("/tasks/", json={"title": "BoundaryTask", "completed": False})
    assert r_create.status_code == 201
    task_id = r_create.json()["id"]
    assert task_id >= 1
    r_put = client3.put(f"/tasks/{task_id}", json={"id": 0, "title": "BoundaryUpdated"})
    assert r_put.status_code == 200
    data = r_put.json()
    assert data["id"] == task_id
    assert data["id"] != 0
    assert data["title"] == "BoundaryUpdated"
    r_get = client3.get(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
    assert r_get.status_code == 200
    assert r_get.json()["id"] == task_id

test_put_body_id_zero_boundary_ignored_url_task_updated()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
